clip_grad_norm: clip gradient norms of model parameters or compute total norm when max_norm is zero
get_clones: create N deep copies of a PyTorch module and return them as an nn.ModuleList
get_norm: build a normalization layer (LayerNorm, BatchNorm2d, or GroupNorm) from a string specifier and channel count
get_activation_fn: return a PyTorch activation function (relu, gelu, or glu) given its string name
data_to_tensor: recursively convert numpy arrays, scalars, dicts, and sequences into PyTorch tensors
